outputs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the receipt in Image 1 into a production-quality 2x2 transparent sprite atlas containing FOUR finish stages of THE SAME mysterious unpurchased return receipt. Image 1 locks the identity, silhouette and pose; Image 2 is only a high-density pixel-art material/style reference, never copy the room. Every cell has the same camera, same scale, same centre, same longest visible edge and same slanted upright paper-scroll pose. Preserve warm ivory receipt paper, mauve/umber postal ink, a curled upper-right lip, and the unmistakable spiral curl at lower right. The face has original short horizontal dash strokes and a distinctive circular return postal stamp with three wavy cancellation lines. No readable letters, numbers, UI words, tier labels or grid lines. Keep the scroll naturally tall and dimensional, and all four silhouettes closely aligned. Top-left stage0 is already exquisite paper with precise soft wear, clean ink layers, rich 2.5D volume. Top-right stage1 adds clearly visible luminous edge fibres, worn/scalloped paper edge and finely crosshatched translucent pulp. Bottom-left stage2 adds crisp crease ridges, a layered spiral curl, richer subtly offset multi-tone postal printing and tiny patinated ink breaks. Bottom-right stage3 adds elegant faint postal-route dotted filigree WITHIN the paper, selective understated bronze-metallic ink on some original printed lines and the postal stamp, fine visible fibre strands and layered curled-paper depth. All stages remain the identical receipt rather than new objects. At a 67px drawing size the main folds, stamp and curl must read clearly; use crisp deliberate pixel clusters and dithered hue steps, never blur, tiny meaningless noise or a smooth vector. No aura, magic particles, highlights outside the paper, glass, pedestal, hand, props, border or shadow on a floor. The four cells are equal squares in an exact 2x2 grid with generous identical transparent margins. Entire outside of every paper has true transparent alpha. Keep all paper silhouettes within their cells. Do not include any background.
outputs.review: Rejected after native67px audit because tier progression emphasized frayed edges and wrinkles. V2 selected for runtime composition review.

No background, no external glow, no floating particle effects, no text, no lettering, no labels, no border, no ground shadow.
